models.name: studio_activity
models.description: Film activity for each studio. One record per studio, including studios without films.

columns.name: studio_id
columns.description: Identifier of the studios row. One row per value.

columns.name: studio_name
columns.description: name of the studios row, copied unchanged.

columns.name: films_count
columns.description: Number of films rows associated with this studios row; 0 when there are none.

columns.name: distinct_genres_count
columns.description: Number of unique genres records associated through films; 0 when there are none. Missing genres records do not count.

columns.name: release_state_films_count
columns.description: Number of associated films rows whose release_state is one of ['released']; 0 when none qualify.

columns.name: total_runtime_minutes
columns.description: Total non-missing runtime_minutes across associated films rows; 0 when there are no values.

columns.name: release_state_runtime_minutes
columns.description: Total non-missing runtime_minutes for associated films rows whose release_state is one of ['released']; 0 when there are no qualifying values.

columns.name: max_runtime_minutes
columns.description: Largest non-missing runtime_minutes across associated films rows; 0 when there are no values.

columns.name: release_state_runtime_minutes_share
columns.description: release_state_runtime_minutes divided by total_runtime_minutes, as a fraction rounded to 4 decimal places; 0.0 when total_runtime_minutes is 0.

columns.name: films_count_band
columns.description: Size band of films_count: 'none' for 0, 'small' for 1–2, 'medium' for 3–5, and 'large' for more than 5.

columns.name: has_films
columns.description: 'yes' when this parent has at least one link, 'no' otherwise. Never NULL.
